about: The Mighty graph of an ACP agent's run (opencode, Hermes) for each shared recording (native/contracts/fixtures/opencode-acp-*.jsonl, hermes-acp-*.jsonl), replayed through the ACP channel, the stream parser and the graph tracker with the case's request and no card answered: what the tracker emitted last for each block, in the order the blocks first came. A request of these agents is one block (kind main, titled by the agent's name): the streamed answer is its output, opencode's prompt result its tokens, Hermes's none (it reports its session's running totals); tool calls, questions and sub-agents' text are not blocks. The run ends completed when the turn completed and nothing failed, else in error. The Mac (MightyCoreTests AcpGraphTests) and the Windows Core (AcpGraphVerification) produce exactly these from the recordings.
